subject: English
question_text: Make five sentences using parts of sentences from each column of the table below. 1  5 =
stimulus: Efforts its interest without struggle Life become not a real triumph if both sides are not equally matched. Games lose dull if there is no competition A victory be one kind of continuous examination Really extremely needed for the progress in life
guide_solution: (a) Efforts are extremely needed for the progress in life. (b) Life is one kind of continuous examination. (c) Games become dull if there is no competition. (d) A victory is not a real triumph if both the sides are not equally matched. (e) Really life loses its interest without struggle.
